component.name: FujiNet Go Intv
component.summary: Self-contained Mattel Intellivision with built-in FujiNet

description.p: A Mattel Intellivision with FujiNet built in: boots straight into FujiNet's config ROM, with a clickable keypad window standing in for both hand controllers so every keypad button and direction disc can be driven with a mouse.

Emulation is provided by a FujiNet-patched jzIntv, with FujiNet attached over Bus-Over-IP (BoIP) on loopback TCP. The debugger covers the CP-1610 CPU and the STIC graphics chip -- registers, mode, the BACKTAB background grid, the 8 MOBs (sprites), and the GRAM/GROM card sheet. Plain Qt6 Widgets, not KDE Frameworks -- Breeze arrives through the platform theme.

Fixes the debugger's GRAM/GROM card sheet pager: the Prev/Next buttons never appeared at all (a layout bug kept them out of the visible widget tree), so only the first 128 GROM/GRAM cards were ever reachable. Paging now works, shows a "cards N-M of total" range, and clamps at both ends instead of wrapping back to the first page. Fixes the keypad's directional disc lighting the wrong side of the dial (top press lit the bottom wedge, etc.) while still sending the correct direction to the emulator; the highlighted wedge is now correctly oriented and matches the sector that actually produces it.

Boots the larger Intellivision cartridges that previously failed with ERR CODE 3, hangs, or corrupted graphics: cartridge memory maps from a .cfg sidecar are now clamped at end-of-file the way SDK-1600's bin2rom does, cartridges whose ROM occupies the FujiNet mailbox window ($9C00-$9F3F) boot with the mailbox disabled for the session instead of being rejected, .cfg [memattr] cartridge RAM declarations are honored, and 40KB/48KB bare .bin images get sensible default maps. The bundled FujiNet runtime now finds .cfg sidecars on hosts with a path prefix set, verifies the pushed byte count, and aborts cleanly on a short transfer instead of booting partial data. The embedded FujiNet config ROM now names the boot-failure reason on screen.

Fixes audio distortion caused by the emulator's output ring buffer being trimmed too aggressively on hosts with a small audio device quantum, and by underruns playing back stale or uninitialized audio instead of silence. Adds a clickable ECS Keyboard window (F10), the on-screen counterpart to the existing hand-controller keypad, so the ECS's own keyboard can be driven entirely with a mouse.

Adds ECS (Entertainment Computer System) support -- a second controller pair, its own keyboard, and extra sound -- plus Intellivoice speech synthesis and NTSC/PAL video switching, all configurable from a new Settings dialog. ECS and Intellivoice default to Auto, matching each cartridge's own preference.
Updated embedded FujiNet config ROM: the HOST SLOTS screen now has a keypad shortcut that mounts and boots the FujiNet Game Lobby directly, with an on-screen hint showing it's available.
First release of the Intellivision KDE/Qt frontend: the same FujiNet-in-process boot, clickable keypad window, and CP-1610/STIC debugger as the GNOME frontend, built on plain Qt6 Widgets.
